Good morning. You look tired today.
I am. I wake up at five thirty every day.
Five thirty? That is very early. I wake up at seven.
You are lucky. I leave home at six and I arrive at the site at seven.
I do not drive here. I take the train from the hotel.
And what time do you have lunch?
At one. I do not eat at the site. I go to a small place near the station.
Do you work in the afternoon too?
Yes, I do. I finish at six, and then I walk to the hotel.
I arrive home at eight, and I am very tired. But I do not work on Saturday.

Good morning. This is the site safety message. Work starts at seven o'clock. The first break is at nine thirty. Lunch is from twelve to one. The afternoon break is at three. Work finishes at five o'clock. Please do not enter the tunnel after five. Thank you.

My name is Ana and I do not work in an office. I am a nurse at the city hospital. I start at seven at night and I finish at seven in the morning. I sleep in the day. I do not have lunch. I have dinner at six in the evening, before work. On Sunday I do not work, and I see my family.
Giovanna wakes up at five thirty. She leaves home at six. She arrives at the site at seven. She has lunch at twelve. She goes home at eight in the evening.
